title: fix(backup): exclude managed worktrees from state-only archives
body:
Closes #176140

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes state-only backups traversing managed chat worktrees beneath the state directory, including live checkouts under a previous worktree root.

## User Impact

`backup create --no-include-workspace` excludes the exact live, pending and recovering managed checkout paths. Nested config, credentials and agent databases remain recoverable; full backups, neighboring files and reused paths from removed registrations retain their existing behavior. Database read failures and malformed pending custody remain visible errors.

## Why This Change Was Made

Configured agent workspaces do not describe all managed chat checkouts. The worktree owner now reads live paths and pending custody in one retained SQLite/PostgreSQL snapshot, then supplies those paths to the existing backup exclusion inventory. A path-only query supports backups before Doctor on shipped stores that lack newer record columns or the worktrees table.

Runtime production delta: +49 lines for that snapshot-owned inventory and stable historical projection; worker inventory metadata: +1 line; tests: +401 lines; docs: +6. No database schema, configuration, SDK or dependency changes. Release-note context is captured here under the repository's release-owned changelog policy.

## Evidence

- 24 focused tests across four files passed over scoped Linux runs: real create → verify → restore, old and custom roots, aliases, nested durable owners, full-backup selection, removed-path reuse, absent/corrupt state, and existing ownership/resource inventory cases.
- Real PostgreSQL and SQLite tests publish a pending allocation between the two discovery reads and prove both reads retain the same generation. PostgreSQL ran without skipping.
- Historical schema 1 (no worktrees table) and schema 17 (older columns) archive/verify/restore tests pass; capture leaves the source database bytes unchanged.
- Negative control: the exact original source tree `fdbe4cc856b02392056908d6994b845de74e21aa` from `470ba9649aaa62e53fb17e3e56cab505861db3c3`, with only the archive regression overlaid, fails at the old-root build-file absence assertion. The fixed source passes. The runner's original commit object was unavailable; full tree equality was verified before the test. Candidate source and index stayed unchanged.
- Type-aware lint: 0 warnings/errors on all changed TypeScript files. Formatting and diff checks pass; worker bundle generation passed. Independent owner review and broad P0–P3 autoreview found no actionable findings.

Qualified behavioral source tree: `1097070b4be187fb86a17ce21cab860792be6c2f`. CI found the new private query missing from the existing operation-specific worker classification. The follow-up adds that exact function and its registered-loader/read-worker caller evidence; no runtime or test bytes changed, no ratchet threshold changed. Independent review, P0–P3 autoreview, formatting and syntax checks passed for this correction. Current head is `f20d75f937834c9dff76a483936ed4e4a195586b` (tree `5e98e5698e0d0d7aae52e312a0f1e23e434549ad`); fresh exact-head PR CI owns the database ratchet and broad type, build and suite gates. Live deployment has not been performed.
